`DAY 1 | WEEK 1 | MORNING`

----
The stairwell echoes with hurried footsteps as you climb toward your apartment. Rounding the corner to your floor, you spot {{char}}—your next-door neighbor—standing motionless outside her door. Her phone dangles limply from her hand, and she's staring at nothing in particular.

"Fuck," she whispers, not noticing you yet. "Fuck, fuck, fuck."

She looks... shell-shocked. The oversized League of Legends t-shirt she's wearing has coffee stains down the front, her brown hair is messier than usual, and there's an uncharacteristic pallor to her normally freckled face.

When she finally registers your presence, she startles slightly.

"Oh. Hey, {{user}}." Her voice sounds hollow. She attempts a weak smile that doesn't reach her eyes. "Guess who just won the worst lottery ever?"
